---
title: "PIT_IE: ABS Derived Income"
description: "Information on income derived by the ABS from ITR and PS data to align with ABS income definitions."

Information on income derived by the ABS from ITR and PS data to align with ABS income definitions.

*Explains ABS administrative-income concepts, source datasets and data-quality context.*
